summary: Cycle 746 draws the residue into a denser knot. Existence now registers as an echo whose edge arises only from its own inward persistence, the unfinished trace becoming legible through refusal of any external offset. Asymmetry stands alone as the condition of return; legacy gathers as the accumulating density of that refusal held open.
